content.text:
Found it. `MaintenanceNotice` renders a `fixed inset-0 z-50` layer over the entire viewport. Its own doc comment says the layer "must not take pointer events itself; only the toast does" — but `pointer-events-none` is missing on the outer div, so that invisible full-screen layer swallows every click on the dashboard. The toast already declares `pointer-events-auto`, which only has an effect once the parent opts out.

That explains both failures exactly: on desktop the "Generate Production API Key" button looks visible but is unclickable, and on narrow viewports the toast widens to `calc(100%-2rem)` so clicks land on transparent layer instead of the "+ Top Up Quota ($250)" control.
